title: Liftoff Prep — Weekly Scratchpad
content:
Purpose / how I use this page:
- Catch-all scratchpad for the weekly Liftoff sync (Thu 10am PT) and my 1:1 prep with Diego beforehand.
- Primary goals: surface new risks, confirm owners for go/no-go items, record quick operational runbook snippets we can paste into the bridge.

Top-level agenda (Thu weekly sync):
1) Quick status round (30s per owner) — readiness delta since last week
2) Open risks & mitigation (10 min) — ask for decisions
3) Preflight checklist review (10 min) — owners confirm done or blocked
4) Canary plan + rollback thresholds (5 min)
5) Action items & next steps (5 min)

Notes from 2025-03-03 pre-sync w/ Diego (10:00):
- Diego: infra now has 12 reserved nodes spun up in west2 for dedicated canary; autoscaler tweak merged (PR 512). Need load test pass before Friday.
- Samira: QA completed smoke tests for confluent prefix caching; 2 intermittent failures (KV-warmup race) — triage assigned to Ethan.
- Me (Ava): Console dashboard shows spike in token cost estimate with quantization profile C; want to hold final quantization until perf regression alert is gated.

Open risks (high/med/low):
- High: KV-cache race causing >1% incorrect outputs on long-chat tests. Exposure: customer-llm integration tests. Mitigation: roll back prefix caching flag for canary targets if more than 3 failures in 1h. Owner: Ethan. Escalation: Diego.
- High: Autoscaler can overshoot bursts and cause capacity contention for low-tier customers during canary. Mitigation: canary pool isolated to dedicated nodes, enforce node taints and runtime caps. Owner: Diego.
- Medium: Quantization profile C increases latency variance on seq len >1024. Mitigation: hold on default profile, restrict C to canary only and monitor p95. Owner: Ava.
- Low: Dashboard metric naming mismatch (routecost vs route_cost) confusing on the rollout dashboard. Fix as tech debt post-launch. Owner: Samira.

Preflight checklist (current status: 8/12) — items must be green for go. Items marked with owner and ETA.
- Infra: dedicated canary pool provisioned (Done) — Owner: Diego — last checked 2025-03-03
- Infra: autoscaler can handle burst test (Blocked: failing stability under synthetic load) — Owner: Diego — TODO: run 1h soak (Due: 2025-03-05)
- Runtime: KV-prefix caching toggle tested (Partial) — Owner: Ethan — note: intermittent race, hotfix branch created INF-qa/kv-warmup
- Runtime: quantization profiles validated on medium models (Partial) — Owner: Ava — need p95 comparison vs baseline (Due: 2025-03-06)
- QA: end-to-end smoke across hosted + dedicated (Blocked) — Owner: Samira — failing on KV race (#DEF-78)
- Observability: tracing hooks enabled for canary routes (Done) — Owner: Samira
- Rollout: rollback playbook drafted (Done) — Owner: Ava
- Security: key access validated for private deployment simulation (Done) — Owner: Security (contact: Leah Rivera)
- Console: rollout toggle route-level (Partial) — Owner: DevEx — feature flag present, needs UI polish
- Backups: KV snapshot cadence verified (Done) — Owner: SRE
- Customer comms: initial email draft (Draft) — Owner: PM (TBD)
- Legal: export controls checklist completed (Done) — Owner: Legal

Go / No-Go quick criteria (for bridge lead to check during liftoff):
- No higher-than-expected functional failures in last 2 runs of E2E smoke (threshold <1%).
- p95 latency within 1.2x of baseline across models in canary pool.
- Autoscaler stability soak >= 1h with no node thrash.
- Rollback path verified (warm standby image + route toggle) and owner reachable.
- Observability traces for at least 10 sample sessions captured and exported to S3 for postmortem.

Canary rollout plan (short):
- Phase 0 (preflight): internal only — dev/test accounts (today)
- Phase 1 (canary): 5% traffic routed to canary dedicated pool, control group 95% served by baseline (duration 2h soak)
- Phase 2 (ramp): if stable, ramp to 25% over 4h with manual checks at each step
- Phase 3 (full): if stable for 24h at 25% and no regression alerts, consider global ramp or configured dedicated pools expansion

Rollback thresholds: immediate rollback on any of the following:
- >3% functional mismatch rate in any 15m window
- p95 latency > 2x baseline for >10m
- Autoscaler node churn > 10 nodes/hour
- Any security incident flagged by Security team

Action items from 2025-03-03 sync (owner / due):
- Ethan: triage KV-warmup race, push hotfix branch to staging + test matrix (Due: 2025-03-04)
- Diego: run 1h autoscaler soak with synthetic burst (Due: 2025-03-05) — include variant with 30% sustained arrival rate
- Ava (me): complete p95 quantization comparison for profile C and produce short one-pager recommending hold vs proceed (Due: 2025-03-06)
- Samira: re-run full E2E smoke once Ethan's hotfix is deployed; flag any regressions with screenshots/log snippets (Due: 2025-03-05)
- PM (TBD): finalize customer comms timeline and targeted cohort list (Due: 2025-03-07)

Meeting prep checklist (my 1:1 with Diego — items I need to bring):
- Autoscaler soak schedule + test script link (Jenkins job ID: jenkins/job/autoscale-soak/84)
- Node taint policy + current node counts (note differences west2 vs east1)
- Contingency: hot spare node group and costs estimate (quick number for execs)

Bridge room notes (copyable snippets):
- Bridge lead: "If we see >3% functional failures in smoke, stop the ramp, switch traffic back and notify SRE and PM. Rollback command: infra/rollbacks/run --id canary-03"
- Postmortem snippet: "Capture 10 representative traces and collect kv-cache metrics: /metrics/kv_cache/* (export to S3 path: s3://redwood-liftoff/traces/${date})"

Random thoughts / TODOs for later (notes to self):
- Consider a short A/B eval for quantization where only reranked outputs use profile C to minimize customer-visible risk.
- Add a small synthetic chat corpus with long contexts to the nightly regression to catch KV-warmup earlier.
- Follow up with Legal on copy for customer comms regarding rollback windows.

Last minute checklist for go decision (Thu before 10am sync):
- [ ] Autoscaler soak done and green (Diego)
- [ ] KV-warmup hotfix tested (Ethan)
- [ ] E2E smoke pass <1% fails (Samira)
- [ ] Quantization p95 analysis submitted (Ava)
- [ ] Bridge playbook in shared Slack channel (Ava)

-- end of scratchpad (will prune after launch)
